description: Read, recheck, watch, renew, fork, or download a saved output passport. read: GET /v1/passports/{token}. recheck: POST /v1/passports/{token}/fresh. fork_draft: GET /v1/passports/{token}/fork. fork: POST /v1/passports/{token}/fork; body: title, description, category, amount_usd; idempotency_key in body or Idempotency-Key header. watch_read: GET /v1/passports/{token}/watch. watch_update: POST /v1/passports/{token}/watch; body: enabled. renewal_draft: GET /v1/passports/{token}/renew. renew: POST /v1/passports/{token}/renew; body: idempotency_key; optional amount_usd. download: GET /v1/passports/{token}/download.

inputSchema.description: Required by action: read: token; recheck: token and idempotency_key; fork_draft: token; fork: token, agent_key and body; watch_read: token and agent_key; watch_update: token, agent_key and body; renewal_draft: token; renew: token, agent_key and body; download: token.

body.description: REST JSON body for the chosen action. See its documented fields in the action description and OpenAPI.
